description: Lista completa de las centrales eléctricas de España. All 2,987 power generation and storage units in Spain from the powerplantmatching (PyPSA) merged European power plant dataset: name, fuel type, technology, capacity (MW), efficiency, commissioning/retrofit/retirement year, coordinates, storage attributes (duration, reservoir volume, dam height, storage capacity), ENTSO-E EIC codes and cross-referenced upstream source IDs (MaStR, ENTSO-E, JRC, GEM, GPD, OPSD, GEO and others).

meta.title: Centrales eléctricas de España - Descarga gratuita
meta.description: Lista completa de las centrales eléctricas de España. All 2,987 power generation and storage units in Spain from the powerplantmatching (PyPSA) merged European power plant dataset: name, fuel type, technology, capacity (MW), efficiency, commissioning/retrofit/retirement year, coordinates, storage attributes (duration, reservoir volume, dam height, storage capacity), ENTSO-E EIC codes and cross-referenced upstream source IDs (MaStR, ENTSO-E, JRC, GEM, GPD, OPSD, GEO and others). Contiene 2987 registros. Descargar en formatos Excel, CSV, PDF.
